title: IAX figure
description: One figure, derived from an artifact and carrying that artifact's sha256. A model-view is re-rendered from the render block; a manual figure is allowed but must be registered with by and date, and audit names the ones that are not.

section.description: The report section this figure belongs to; the outline assigns it, the author does not hand-type the figure number.

source.description: A pointer into result.json.artifacts, never a bare filename: the hash is what makes an old picture of a new model detectable.

view.description: iso | top | front | side | section:<k> | current; the section presets read their axes from the document.

camera.description: panX, panY, rotX, rotY, zoom; when present it beats view, as it does in the renderer.

legend_groups.description: Path to the renderer's --legend-groups JSON, when this figure uses grouped legend rows.

by.description: Manual figures only: who made it.

date.description: Manual figures only: when it was made.
